title: Mid-month roadmap signal brief & operator action lanes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a concise mid-month executive signal brief (one A4 / two slides) that summarizes signal health for active roadmap initiatives, surface three prioritized asks for execs, and provide operator action lanes for eng/product/design leads. The deliverable should be consumable in an 8–10 minute read and include: 1) top-line momentum metrics (OKR velocity, M0 cost/$, latency SLO risk), 2) two downside scenarios with contingency actions, and 3) three specific decisions or resource asks tied to measurable outcomes. This ticket covers drafting the brief, routing for stakeholder feedback, and preparing the short readout script for the monthly leadership sync.
acceptance_criteria: One consolidated brief (PDF + single-slide summary) uploaded to Confluence and Drive
Three prioritized exec asks with measurable success criteria and proposed owners
Operator action lanes mapped to triggers (SLO thresholds, cost delta, adoption velocity)
Stakeholder feedback incorporated from Eng, Design, Sales, and Customer Success
Readout script (<= 8 minutes) drafted and rehearsed with presenter(s)
